title: 第二十九章     再见蓝湘
content_zh:
终于走到了蓝湘所在的区域，此刻的琼霄孤身一人，在进入这片区域之时，李朗撂下了一句话：“我才不去当看你们亲亲我我咧，我自己去玩了，等会见！”

    先前蓝湘离开时，告诉了琼霄她住在哪间宿舍，确定了位置之后，琼霄站在了蓝湘所住的楼下，但是看着进进出出的女生，脸上不禁有些尴尬，“走进女生宿舍，估计有些不方便吧！”思索了一下，琼霄还是决定找一个女生问问的好，琼霄的目光开始转动了起来，看到一个女子从里面走了出来，琼霄走上前去。

    “你好！请问蓝湘是否住在这里！”琼霄轻声问道。

    “你是谁？”那个女孩抬起头紧盯着琼霄，眼里有一些疑惑，更甚至有一丝警惕。

    闻言，琼霄微微一愣，面色尴尬的说道：“你好，我叫琼霄，有点事找她。”

    “你就是琼霄！”那女孩子眼前一亮，不由得说道。

    “学姐知道我？”琼霄突然疑惑起来。

    “咯咯，知道啊，我那可怜的湘儿输给了你，整天在我们身旁念叨，你是如何如何的厉害，我们耳朵都出老茧了！”那女孩掩嘴笑道。

    闻言，琼霄心中有些感动，蓝湘居然天天能天天想到他，随即微微一笑道：“那个学姐，那蓝湘在宿舍吗？”

    “在啊，不过你能有什么事找她？”那女孩靠近琼霄耳边轻声道。

    “额，我真有事找她！麻烦你帮我叫一叫她！”

    那女孩听后，不由得说道：“你这借口也太差了，要知道，每天来找湘儿的人不知道有多少，要是每个都要告诉，那我岂不是累死！换个新的借口再来吧！”

    琼霄听后有些愣神，“有很多人找湘儿？”随后想想也是，怎么说蓝湘也是个绝色美女，找的人怎么会少呢！旋即无奈的叹了口气说道：“我真的有事找她！”

    闻言，那个女孩眉头皱了皱，说道：“我懒得和你纠缠，我走了！”随后朝前走去。

    “那个学姐，我真的有事找她，”琼霄深吸了一口气，追上女孩的脚步。

    女孩停下脚步，道：“没见过你那么死缠烂打的，既然你想见她，那么你给我一个信服的理由，要不然我是不会帮你叫她的！”

    琼霄自己随即说道：“那个我是他男朋友！”

    “啊哦！真的假的啊！湘儿从没有和任何男子接触过，我都不知道他什么时候有了男友，而且还是新生！你有什么证明你是她男朋友！”那女孩听后，怀疑了起来。

    琼霄微微一怔，貌似自己没有什么证明，看这样子，那女孩估计不会帮他，有些无奈的苦笑着，摇了摇头。

    既然如此，那我只能如此了……

    望着女生宿舍区，琼霄深吸了一口气，双手合拢做成喇叭状围在口边，大喊道：“蓝湘！我是琼霄！出来一下！”喊完，又大声的重复了几遍，这使得身旁的女孩有些愣神，更引来周围那些异样的目光。，

    琼霄有些无奈，这也是没有办法的办法，只有这样，或许蓝湘能听的到。

    “琼霄！他怎么来了？”在床榻上休息的蓝湘突然张开了双瞳，标致的小脸上露出了开心的笑容，迅速走到窗边打开了窗，看向楼下的琼霄，此时，琼霄也发现了蓝湘，两人皆脸上露出了笑容，随后蓝湘关起了窗，迈着碎步朝楼下走去。

    “你真的是湘儿男朋友？”那女孩有些不可思议的盯着琼霄。

    “额，你不信你去问湘儿。”琼霄无奈道。

    女孩听后，脸色不由一红，道：“不好意思，我还以为是来骚扰湘儿的！”

    “没关系，你这也是为湘儿好，说起来我还得感谢你呢，改天我请你吃饭去。”闻言，琼霄不由的一笑，道。

    看着琼霄温和的笑容，女孩不由的愣神，而此时，蓝湘已从楼上走了下来。

    “你怎么来了？”蓝湘轻声道。
content_en:
Finally arriving at the area where Lan Xiang was, Qiong Xiao was alone at the moment. When entering the area, Li Lang said something: "I don't want to watch you kiss me. I'm going to play by myself. See you later!"

    When Lan Xiang left earlier, she told Qiong Xiao which dormitory she lived in. After confirming the location, Qiong Xiao stood downstairs where Lan Xiang lived, but looking at the girls coming in and out, she couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed on her face, "It must be a little inconvenient to walk into the girls' dormitory!" After thinking about it, Qiong Xiao decided to ask a girl. Qiong Xiao's eyes began to turn, and she saw a woman coming out of it. Qiong Xiao stepped forward.

    "Hello! May I ask if Lan Xiang lives here?" Qiong Xiao asked softly.

    "Who are you?" The girl raised her head and stared at Qiong Xiao, with some doubts and even a hint of vigilance in her eyes.

    Hearing this, Qiong Xiao was slightly startled, and said with an embarrassed look: "Hello, my name is Qiong Xiao. I have something to ask her."

    "You are Qiong Xiao!" The girl's eyes lit up and she couldn't help but say.

    "Senior, do you know me?" Qiong Xiao suddenly became confused.

    "Giggle, I know, my poor Xiang'er lost to you. She keeps talking to us all day long about how awesome you are. We have calluses on our ears!" The girl covered her mouth and laughed.

    Hearing this, Qiong Xiao felt a little moved. Lan Xiang actually thought of him every day. Then she smiled slightly and said, "Sister, is Lan Xiang in the dormitory?"

    "Yes, but what can you do to her?" The girl approached Qiong Xiao and whispered in her ear.

    "Well, I really have something to do with her! Please help me call her!"

    After hearing this, the girl couldn't help but said: "Your excuse is too bad. You know, there are countless people who come to Xiang'er every day. If everyone has to tell me, then I will be exhausted! Let's come back with a new excuse!"

    Qiong Xiao was a little stunned after hearing this, "A lot of people are looking for Xiang'er?" Then she thought about it, after all, Lan Xiang is also a stunning beauty, how come there are so few people looking for her! Then he sighed helplessly and said, "I really have something to ask her for!"

    Hearing this, the girl frowned and said, "I'm too lazy to bother with you, I'm leaving!" Then she walked forward.

    "That senior sister, I really have something to ask her for," Qiong Xiao took a deep breath and caught up with the girl.

    The girl stopped and said, "I've never seen you being so persistent. Since you want to see her, give me a convincing reason, otherwise I won't call her for you!"

    Qiong Xiao himself said immediately: "That I am his boyfriend!"

    "Oh! It's true! Xiang'er has never been in contact with any man. I don't know when he had a boyfriend, and he was still a freshman! What proof do you have that you are her boyfriend!" After hearing this, the girl became suspicious.

    Qiong Xiao was slightly startled. It seemed that he had no proof. From the looks of it, the girl probably wouldn't help him. She smiled helplessly and shook her head.

    If that's the case, then that's all I can do...

    Looking at the girls' dormitory area, Qiong Xiao took a deep breath, put her hands together to make a trumpet shape around her mouth, and shouted: "Lan Xiang! I am Qiong Xiao! Come out!" After shouting, she repeated it loudly several times, which made the girls beside her stunned and attracted strange looks from those around her. ,

    Qiong Xiao was a little helpless. There was no other way. Only in this way, maybe Lan Xiang could hear it.

    "Qiong Xiao! Why is he here?" Lan Xiang, who was resting on the bed, suddenly opened his eyes, and a happy smile appeared on his pretty face. He quickly walked to the window, opened it, and looked at Qiong Xiao downstairs. At this time, Qiong Xiao also spotted Lan Xiang, and both of them had smiles on their faces. Then Lan Xiang closed the window and walked downstairs with small steps.

    "Are you really Xiang'er's boyfriend?" The girl stared at Qiong Xiao in disbelief.

    "Well, if you don't believe me, just ask Xiang'er." Qiong Xiao said helplessly.

    After hearing this, the girl's face turned red and said, "Sorry, I thought you were here to harass Xiang'er!"

    "It doesn't matter, you are doing this for Xiang'er's own good. Speaking of which, I have to thank you. I will treat you to dinner another day." Hearing this, Qiong Xiao couldn't help but smile and said.

    Looking at Qiong Xiao's gentle smile, the girl couldn't help but be stunned. At this time, Lan Xiang had already walked downstairs.

    "Why are you here?" Lan Xiang asked softly.
